summary.ja: 1〜256ノードIOR/mdtestの時間分散3ラウンドを集計。成功861 phase測定、通常9反復、64ノードhardのみ3反復。64ノードhard round2は600秒timeout、round3保留。256ノードhardはround1で3600秒timeout、以後保留。欠測は0ではありません。中央値と最大値をグラフ表示。Foundation未検証、公式・合成スコアではありません。既存MLPerf pilot等16件は保持。
summary.en: Aggregates three time-separated IOR/mdtest rounds across 1–256 nodes: 861 successful phase observations; usually 9 trials, but 64-node IOR hard has 3. The 64-node hard round 2 timed out at 600 seconds and round 3 was held. The 256-node hard write timed out at 3600 seconds in round 1 and later rounds were held. Hard coverage remains incomplete; missing is not zero. Graphs show median and maximum. Foundation unverified; no official or composite score. The 16 existing observations, including MLPerf pilots, are preserved.

title.ja: IOR easy型 / write

status.ja: 容量限定のIO500-inspired実験・Foundation未検証（unverified）・公式スコアではありません
status.en: Bounded IO500-inspired experiment; unverified by IO500® Foundation; not an official score

results.software: IOR 4.0.0 / commit 967a9f65109760db8a3ac14a7fdd007f337d2960; reference IO500 SC26 v1

conditions.ja: 1ノード、4 MPI ranks、POSIX、3独立反復。2 MiB transfer・16 GiB/rank・file per process。barrier、fsync、read reorder offset=1、timestamp signature=27。読込は-Rのデータ検証を含みます。
conditions.en: 1 node, 4 MPI ranks, POSIX, 3 independent repetitions. 2 MiB transfer・16 GiB/rank・file per process. Barriers, fsync, read reorder offset=1, timestamp signature=27; reads include -R data verification.

limitations.ja: IO500 SC26 v1を参照した固定容量実験。300秒write stonewallなし、IOR版も参照実装のpinと異なります。mdtest/findを含むIO500総合スコアを計算していません。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume experiment based on IO500 SC26 v1, without 300-second write stonewall; IOR version differs from the reference pin. No IO500 composite score calculated.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。1ノード内のreorderでは共有page cacheを排除できません。logical bytes/timeであり物理デバイス帯域は未検証。 キャッシュ条件は未制御です。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O without global cache flush; same-node reorder cannot remove shared page cache. Logical bytes/time; physical device bandwidth unverified. Cache conditions are uncontrolled.

limitations.ja: hardは約1.751 GiB/反復で短時間。全反復と変動を保持し、専有環境の最大性能とは解釈しません。
limitations.en: Hard uses approximately 1.751 GiB per repetition and is short. All repetitions and variability retained; not dedicated-system peak performance.

limitations.ja: 2026-10-04に取得したSC26 v1参照条件を使用。SC26の安定化期間（10月2–16日）中のため最終確定仕様とは扱いません。
limitations.en: Uses SC26 v1 reference conditions captured on 2026-10-04 during the October 2–16 stabilization period; not treated as finalized specifications.

reproduction.commands:
# 1 node, 4 MPI ranks. Run phases in this order for each independent trial.
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/easy-$trial" "$OUT"
  mpirun -np 4 "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 16g -s 1 -w > "$OUT/easy-$trial-write.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 4 "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 16g -s 1 -r -R > "$OUT/easy-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
done

notes.ja: 内部の実行パスのみ変数に置換しています。空の専用ディレクトリを用意し、DATAを測定対象ファイルシステム、OUTをログ保存先、BINを実行バイナリのディレクトリに設定してください。計測値は共有環境・未制御キャッシュの観測で、同じ値の再現を保証しません。
notes.en: Only private execution paths are replaced by variables. Use empty dedicated directories; set DATA to the measured filesystem, OUT to log storage, BIN to the binary directory. Shared-system and uncontrolled-cache observations do not guarantee identical performance.

notes.ja: IOR 4.0.0の記載commitでビルドしたIOR/mdtestと互換MPIを使用します。各反復は新しいデータ領域で実行し、write→readまたはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順を保持。グローバルcache flushは実施していません。
notes.en: Use IOR/mdtest built from the recorded IOR 4.0.0 commit with compatible MPI. Use a fresh dataset per repetition and preserve write→read or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove order. No global cache flush was performed.

title.ja: mdtest easy型 / create

status.ja: 容量限定のIO500-inspired実験・Foundation未検証（unverified）・公式スコアではありません
status.en: Bounded IO500-inspired experiment; unverified by IO500® Foundation; not an official score

results.software: mdtest / IOR 4.0.0 commit 967a9f65109760db8a3ac14a7fdd007f337d2960; reference IO500 SC26 v1

conditions.ja: 1ノード、4 MPI ranks、POSIX、2000 files/rank（合計8000）、3独立反復、depth=0、branching=1、neighbor stride=1。0-byte files、processごとのunique directory、leafのみ(-u -L)。hard readは-Xデータ検証。IOR完了後に直列実施。
conditions.en: 1 node, 4 MPI ranks, POSIX, 2000 files/rank (8000 total), 3 independent repetitions; depth=0, branching=1, neighbor stride=1. zero-byte files, unique directory per process, leaf only (-u -L). Hard reads use -X verification. Measured serially after IOR.

metrics.label: Pooled rate (total file operations / total time)

limitations.ja: 正式設定100万files/rankから縮小し、300秒create stonewallなし。共有nodeの全I/Oをflushする-Yを省略しました。参照実装のIOR版pinとも異なります。
limitations.en: Reduced from 1 million files/rank; no 300-second create stonewall. Global node sync (-Y) omitted to limit impact on shared users. IOR version differs from reference pin.

limitations.ja: cache flushなし。1ノード内のneighbor strideではpage cacheを除けません。cache影響を受け得るstat/readと短時間・小規模の観測であり最大性能ではありません。 キャッシュ条件は未制御です。
limitations.en: No cache flush; same-node neighbor stride cannot eliminate page cache. Potentially cache-affected stat/read and short bounded observations, not peak performance. Cache conditions are uncontrolled.

limitations.ja: easyに正式IO500 read phaseはありません。未測定readを0で補完していません。hardはcreate/stat/read/remove全段階を保持。
limitations.en: IO500 easy has no read phase; missing read is not imputed as zero. All hard create/stat/read/remove phases retained.

limitations.ja: 2026-10-04に取得したSC26 v1参照条件を使用。SC26の安定化期間（10月2–16日）中のため最終確定仕様とは扱いません。
limitations.en: Uses SC26 v1 reference conditions captured on 2026-10-04 during the October 2–16 stabilization period; not treated as finalized specifications.

limitations.ja: 省略したmdtest -Yはノード全体のsyncです。IOR -Y（各write後fsync）とは異なります。
limitations.en: Omitted mdtest -Y is node-wide sync; distinct from IOR -Y (fsync after each write).

chart_metrics: Pooled rate (total file operations / total time)

reproduction.commands:
# 1 node, 4 MPI ranks. Run phases in this order for each independent trial.

  mpirun -np 4 "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/easy-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -u -L -w 0 -e 0 -C > "$OUT/easy-$trial-create.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 4 "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/easy-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -u -L -w 0 -e 0 -T > "$OUT/easy-$trial-stat.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 4 "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/easy-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -u -L -w 0 -e 0 -r > "$OUT/easy-$trial-remove.log" 2>&1
done

title.ja: IOR easy / read · 時間分散測定

status.ja: 3ラウンドcampaign終了。この条件はround [1, 2, 3]の9成功反復。Foundation未検証・公式スコアではありません。
status.en: Three-round campaign ended; this condition contains 9 valid trials from rounds [1, 2, 3]. Foundation unverified; not an official score

conditions.ja: 1ノード・4 MPI ranks、4 ranks/node、4 GPU/nodeのexclusive allocation（GPU計算なし）、全ノードmemory、POSIX。固定総量512 GiB・strong scaling、2 MiB transfer、file per process。9成功反復、round [1, 2, 3]。
conditions.en: 1 nodes, 4 MPI ranks, 4 ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node exclusive allocation (no GPU computation), all node memory, POSIX. fixed total 512 GiB, strong scaling, 2 MiB transfer, file per process. 9 valid trials; rounds [1, 2, 3].

limitations.ja: 64ノードIOR hard：round1のみ3成功反復。round2の初回writeは600秒でtimeoutしread未到達、round3は保留。256ノードhard：round1の初回writeが3,600秒でtimeout、read未到達、round2/3保留。欠測は0で描画しません。
limitations.en: 64-node IOR hard: only 3 successful round1 trials; round2 first write timed out at600s, read not reached, round3 held. 256-node hard: round1 first write timed out at3,600s, read not reached, rounds2/3 held. Missing values are never plotted as zero.

limitations.ja: 成功反復は通常9回ですが64ノードhardは3回。最大値は反復数の影響を受け、専有システムのpeak性能とは解釈しません。全反復・中央値・平均・範囲・標準偏差を保持しています。
limitations.en: Most conditions have9successful trials;64-node hard has3. Maximum depends on sample count and is not interpreted as dedicated-system peak performance. All trials, median, mean, range and sample deviation are retained.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IOR Q=1は多くが同一ノード内のrank reorderでcold cacheを保証しません。logical bytes/timeまたはoperation rateで、物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境で逐次測定し、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 mostly reorders ranks within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical bytes/time or operation rates, not physical device bandwidth. Serial shared-system observations cannot separate environmental variation from scaling.

limitations.ja: IO500 SC26 v1-inspiredの固定容量実験。300秒stonewallなし、IOR pinも参照実装と異なります。SC26安定化期間中の参照条件で、公式IO500合成スコアは計算していません。従来1ノード64 GiB easyは別系列です。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume IO500 SC26 v1-inspired experiment without300s stonewall and with a different IOR pin from the reference implementation. Reference conditions are from the SC26 stabilization period; no official IO500 composite score. Legacy one-node64GiB easy is a separate series.

limitations.ja: 初期1ノードのmemory不足と128ノード600秒timeoutの診断試行は保持し、修正後のprimary cohort集計から除外。128ノードhardは1,800秒phase capで再測定しました。256ノードeasy round1は失敗allocation内で完了したtrial1を検証し、独立easyのtrial2/3と結合。失敗allocationを成功扱いしていません。
limitations.en: Initial one-node memory failure and128-node600s-timeout diagnostic attempts are retained separately from corrected primary cohorts.128-node hard was remeasured with1,800s phase caps.256-node easy round1 combines verified trial1 from an allocation that later failed in hard with independent easy trials2/3; the failed allocation is not relabeled successful.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 1 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.
# Use module nvhpc-hpcx/26.5 and pinned IOR/mdtest. No GPU computation.
# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial" "$OUT/round-$round"

limitations.ja: 64ノードIOR hard：round1のみ3成功反復。round2の初回writeは600秒でtimeoutしread未到達、round3は保留。256ノードhard：round1の初回writeが3,600秒でtimeout、read未到達、round2/3保留。欠測は0で描画しません。
limitations.en: 64-node IOR hard: only 3 successful round1 trials; round2 first write timed out at600s, read not reached, round3 held. 256-node hard: round1 first write timed out at3,600s, read not reached, rounds2/3 held. Missing values are never plotted as zero.

limitations.ja: 成功反復は通常9回ですが64ノードhardは3回。最大値は反復数の影響を受け、専有システムのpeak性能とは解釈しません。全反復・中央値・平均・範囲・標準偏差を保持しています。
limitations.en: Most conditions have9successful trials;64-node hard has3. Maximum depends on sample count and is not interpreted as dedicated-system peak performance. All trials, median, mean, range and sample deviation are retained.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IOR Q=1は多くが同一ノード内のrank reorderでcold cacheを保証しません。logical bytes/timeまたはoperation rateで、物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境で逐次測定し、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 mostly reorders ranks within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical bytes/time or operation rates, not physical device bandwidth. Serial shared-system observations cannot separate environmental variation from scaling.

limitations.ja: IO500 SC26 v1-inspiredの固定容量実験。300秒stonewallなし、IOR pinも参照実装と異なります。SC26安定化期間中の参照条件で、公式IO500合成スコアは計算していません。従来1ノード64 GiB easyは別系列です。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume IO500 SC26 v1-inspired experiment without300s stonewall and with a different IOR pin from the reference implementation. Reference conditions are from the SC26 stabilization period; no official IO500 composite score. Legacy one-node64GiB easy is a separate series.

limitations.ja: 初期1ノードのmemory不足と128ノード600秒timeoutの診断試行は保持し、修正後のprimary cohort集計から除外。128ノードhardは1,800秒phase capで再測定しました。256ノードeasy round1は失敗allocation内で完了したtrial1を検証し、独立easyのtrial2/3と結合。失敗allocationを成功扱いしていません。
limitations.en: Initial one-node memory failure and128-node600s-timeout diagnostic attempts are retained separately from corrected primary cohorts.128-node hard was remeasured with1,800s phase caps.256-node easy round1 combines verified trial1 from an allocation that later failed in hard with independent easy trials2/3; the failed allocation is not relabeled successful.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 256 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.
# Use module nvhpc-hpcx/26.5 and pinned IOR/mdtest. No GPU computation.
# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial" "$OUT/round-$round"
  mpirun -np 1024 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 536870912 -s 1 -w -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial-write.json" > "$OUT/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial-write.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 1024 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -F -t 2m -b 536870912 -s 1 -r -R -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial-read.json" > "$OUT/round-$round/ior-easy-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitのIOR/mdtest、DATAは測定対象FSの空の専用領域、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。全matrixをnode昇順・条件順で逐次測定し、次roundは前roundの最後の成功条件終了から60分以上後。64ノードhardはround1のみ、256ノードhardは未完了です。
notes.en: BIN contains pinned IOR/mdtest; DATA is an empty dedicated area on the tested FS; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are normalized. Run the matrix serially in ascending node/scenario order; each next round starts at least60min after the final successful condition of the previous round.64-node hard has onlyround1;256-node hard is incomplete.

notes.ja: 各trialはwrite→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順。検証後、生成payloadだけを削除。外部phase timeout：IOR64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒、mdtest300秒。global cache flushは実施していません。
notes.en: Each trial preserves write→read (-R verification) or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove. After validation remove only generated payload. External phase caps: IOR <=64nodes600s;128nodes1800s;256easy3600s;mdtest300s. No global cache flush.

I/O elapsed is IOR internal totalTime or mdtest all-row time. Command wall includes MPI launch and other overhead; pooled rate uses I/O elapsed. limitations.en: 64-node IOR hard: only 3 successful round1 trials; round2 first write timed out at600s, read not reached, round3 held. 256-node hard: round1 first write timed out at3,600s, read not reached, rounds2/3 held. Missing values are never plotted as zero.

limitations.ja: 成功反復は通常9回ですが64ノードhardは3回。最大値は反復数の影響を受け、専有システムのpeak性能とは解釈しません。全反復・中央値・平均・範囲・標準偏差を保持しています。
limitations.en: Most conditions have9successful trials;64-node hard has3. Maximum depends on sample count and is not interpreted as dedicated-system peak performance. All trials, median, mean, range and sample deviation are retained.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IOR Q=1は多くが同一ノード内のrank reorderでcold cacheを保証しません。logical bytes/timeまたはoperation rateで、物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境で逐次測定し、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 mostly reorders ranks within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical bytes/time or operation rates, not physical device bandwidth. Serial shared-system observations cannot separate environmental variation from scaling.

limitations.en: Fixed-volume IO500 SC26 v1-inspired experiment without300s stonewall and with a different IOR pin from the reference implementation. Reference conditions are from the SC26 stabilization period; no official IO500 composite score. Legacy one-node64GiB easy is a separate series.

limitations.ja: 初期1ノードのmemory不足と128ノード600秒timeoutの診断試行は保持し、修正後のprimary cohort集計から除外。128ノードhardは1,800秒phase capで再測定しました。256ノードeasy round1は失敗allocation内で完了したtrial1を検証し、独立easyのtrial2/3と結合。失敗allocationを成功扱いしていません。
limitations.en: Initial one-node memory failure and128-node600s-timeout diagnostic attempts are retained separately from corrected primary cohorts.128-node hard was remeasured with1,800s phase caps.256-node easy round1 combines verified trial1 from an allocation that later failed in hard with independent easy trials2/3; the failed allocation is not relabeled successful.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 32 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.
# Use module nvhpc-hpcx/26.5 and pinned IOR/mdtest. No GPU computation.
# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/round-$round/ior-hard-$trial" "$OUT/round-$round"
  mpirun -np 128 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/round-$round/ior-hard-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t 47008 -b 47008 -s 10000 -w -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/round-$round/ior-hard-$trial-write.json" > "$OUT/round-$round/ior-hard-$trial-write.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 128 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/ior" -a POSIX -g -G 27 -k -e -C -Q 1 -i 1 -o "$DATA/round-$round/ior-hard-$trial/data" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t 47008 -b 47008 -s 10000 -r -R -O summaryFormat=JSON -O summaryFile="$OUT/round-$round/ior-hard-$trial-read.json" > "$OUT/round-$round/ior-hard-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitのIOR/mdtest、DATAは測定対象FSの空の専用領域、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。全matrixをnode昇順・条件順で逐次測定し、次roundは前roundの最後の成功条件終了から60分以上後。64ノードhardはround1のみ、256ノードhardは未完了です。
notes.en: BIN contains pinned IOR/mdtest; DATA is an empty dedicated area on the tested FS; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are normalized. Run the matrix serially in ascending node/scenario order; each next round starts at least60min after the final successful condition of the previous round.64-node hard has onlyround1;256-node hard is incomplete.

notes.ja: 各trialはwrite→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順。検証後、生成payloadだけを削除。外部phase timeout：IOR64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒、mdtest300秒。global cache flushは実施していません。
notes.en: Each trial preserves write→read (-R verification) or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove. After validation remove only generated payload. External phase caps: IOR <=64nodes600s;128nodes1800s;256easy3600s;mdtest300s. No global cache flush.

I/O elapsed is IOR internal totalTime or mdtest all-row time. Command wall includes MPI launch and other overhead; pooled rate uses I/O elapsed. status.ja: 3ラウンドcampaign終了。この条件はround [1, 2, 3]の9成功反復。Foundation未検証・公式スコアではありません。
status.en: Three-round campaign ended; this condition contains 9 valid trials from rounds [1, 2, 3]. Foundation unverified; not an official score

conditions.ja: 4ノード・16 MPI ranks、4 ranks/node、4 GPU/nodeのexclusive allocation（GPU計算なし）、全ノードmemory、POSIX。2,000 files/rank、unique directory、0 byte payload。9成功反復、round [1, 2, 3]。
conditions.en: 4 nodes, 16 MPI ranks, 4 ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node exclusive allocation (no GPU computation), all node memory, POSIX. 2,000 files/rank, unique directory, 0 byte payload. 9 valid trials; rounds [1, 2, 3].

limitations.ja: 64ノードIOR hard：round1のみ3成功反復。round2の初回writeは600秒でtimeoutしread未到達、round3は保留。256ノードhard：round1の初回writeが3,600秒でtimeout、read未到達、round2/3保留。欠測は0で描画しません。
limitations.en: 64-node IOR hard: only 3 successful round1 trials; round2 first write timed out at600s, read not reached, round3 held. 256-node hard: round1 first write timed out at3,600s, read not reached, rounds2/3 held. Missing values are never plotted as zero.

limitations.ja: 成功反復は通常9回ですが64ノードhardは3回。最大値は反復数の影響を受け、専有システムのpeak性能とは解釈しません。全反復・中央値・平均・範囲・標準偏差を保持しています。
limitations.en: Most conditions have9successful trials;64-node hard has3. Maximum depends on sample count and is not interpreted as dedicated-system peak performance. All trials, median, mean, range and sample deviation are retained.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IOR Q=1は多くが同一ノード内のrank reorderでcold cacheを保証しません。logical bytes/timeまたはoperation rateで、物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境で逐次測定し、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 mostly reorders ranks within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical bytes/time or operation rates, not physical device bandwidth. Serial shared-system observations cannot separate environmental variation from scaling.

limitations.ja: IO500 SC26 v1-inspiredの固定容量実験。300秒stonewallなし、IOR pinも参照実装と異なります。SC26安定化期間中の参照条件で、公式IO500合成スコアは計算していません。従来1ノード64 GiB easyは別系列です。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume IO500 SC26 v1-inspired experiment without300s stonewall and with a different IOR pin from the reference implementation. Reference conditions are from the SC26 stabilization period; no official IO500 composite score. Legacy one-node64GiB easy is a separate series.

limitations.ja: 初期1ノードのmemory不足と128ノード600秒timeoutの診断試行は保持し、修正後のprimary cohort集計から除外。128ノードhardは1,800秒phase capで再測定しました。256ノードeasy round1は失敗allocation内で完了したtrial1を検証し、独立easyのtrial2/3と結合。失敗allocationを成功扱いしていません。
limitations.en: Initial one-node memory failure and128-node600s-timeout diagnostic attempts are retained separately from corrected primary cohorts.128-node hard was remeasured with1,800s phase caps.256-node easy round1 combines verified trial1 from an allocation that later failed in hard with independent easy trials2/3; the failed allocation is not relabeled successful.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 4 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.
# Use module nvhpc-hpcx/26.5 and pinned IOR/mdtest. No GPU computation.
# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial" "$OUT/round-$round"
  mpirun -np 16 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -u -L -w 0 -e 0 -C --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial-create.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial-create.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 16 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -u -L -w 0 -e 0 -T --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial-stat.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial-stat.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 16 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -u -L -w 0 -e 0 -r --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial-remove.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-easy-$trial-remove.log" 2>&1
  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitのIOR/mdtest、DATAは測定対象FSの空の専用領域、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。全matrixをnode昇順・条件順で逐次測定し、次roundは前roundの最後の成功条件終了から60分以上後。64ノードhardはround1のみ、256ノードhardは未完了です。
notes.en: BIN contains pinned IOR/mdtest; DATA is an empty dedicated area on the tested FS; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are normalized. Run the matrix serially in ascending node/scenario order; each next round starts at least60min after the final successful condition of the previous round.64-node hard has onlyround1;256-node hard is incomplete.

notes.ja: 各trialはwrite→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順。検証後、生成payloadだけを削除。外部phase timeout：IOR64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒、mdtest300秒。global cache flushは実施していません。
notes.en: Each trial preserves write→read (-R verification) or create→stat→read (hard only)→remove. After validation remove only generated payload. External phase caps: IOR <=64nodes600s;128nodes1800s;256easy3600s;mdtest300s. No global cache flush.

I/O elapsed is IOR internal totalTime or mdtest all-row time. Command wall includes MPI launch and other overhead; pooled rate uses I/O elapsed. limitations.ja: 成功反復は通常9回ですが64ノードhardは3回。最大値は反復数の影響を受け、専有システムのpeak性能とは解釈しません。全反復・中央値・平均・範囲・標準偏差を保持しています。

# Allocate 1 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.

# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do

  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.
done

Run the matrix serially in ascending node/scenario order; each next round starts at least60min after the final successful condition of the previous round.64-node hard has onlyround1;256-node hard is incomplete.

notes.ja: 各trialはwrite→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順。検証後、生成payloadだけを削除。外部phase timeout：IOR64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒、mdtest300秒。global cache flushは実施していません。

# Allocate 128 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.

: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"

  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.

notes.ja: 各trialはwrite→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順。検証後、生成payloadだけを削除。外部phase timeout：IOR64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒、mdtest300秒。global cache flushは実施していません。

# Allocate 256 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.
# Use module nvhpc-hpcx/26.5 and pinned IOR/mdtest. No GPU computation.
# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" "$OUT/round-$round"

  mpirun -np 1024 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -T --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.log" 2>&1

  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.
done

notes.en: BIN contains pinned IOR/mdtest; DATA is an empty dedicated area on the tested FS; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are normalized. notes.ja: 各trialはwrite→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順。検証後、生成payloadだけを削除。外部phase timeout：IOR64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒、mdtest300秒。global cache flushは実施していません。

# Allocate 1 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.

: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 2 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.
# Use module nvhpc-hpcx/26.5 and pinned IOR/mdtest. No GPU computation.
# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" "$OUT/round-$round"
  mpirun -np 8 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -C --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 8 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -T --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.log" 2>&1

  mpirun -np 8 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -r --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.log" 2>&1
  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.
done

notes.en: BIN contains pinned IOR/mdtest; DATA is an empty dedicated area on the tested FS; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are normalized. Run the matrix serially in ascending node/scenario order; each next round starts at least60min after the final successful condition of the previous round.64-node hard has onlyround1;256-node hard is incomplete.

notes.ja: 各trialはwrite→read（-R検証）またはcreate→stat→read（hardのみ）→removeの順。検証後、生成payloadだけを削除。外部phase timeout：IOR64ノード以下600秒、128ノード1800秒、256 easy3600秒、mdtest300秒。global cache flushは実施していません。

conditions.ja: 256ノード・1024 MPI ranks、4 ranks/node、4 GPU/nodeのexclusive allocation（GPU計算なし）、全ノードmemory、POSIX。2,000 files/rank、shared tree、3,901 byte write/read payload。9成功反復、round [1, 2, 3]。
conditions.en: 256 nodes, 1024 MPI ranks, 4 ranks/node, 4 GPUs/node exclusive allocation (no GPU computation), all node memory, POSIX. 2,000 files/rank, shared tree, 3,901 byte write/read payload. 9 valid trials; rounds [1, 2, 3].

limitations.ja: 64ノードIOR hard：round1のみ3成功反復。round2の初回writeは600秒でtimeoutしread未到達、round3は保留。256ノードhard：round1の初回writeが3,600秒でtimeout、read未到達、round2/3保留。欠測は0で描画しません。
limitations.en: 64-node IOR hard: only 3 successful round1 trials; round2 first write timed out at600s, read not reached, round3 held. 256-node hard: round1 first write timed out at3,600s, read not reached, rounds2/3 held. Missing values are never plotted as zero.

limitations.ja: 成功反復は通常9回ですが64ノードhardは3回。最大値は反復数の影響を受け、専有システムのpeak性能とは解釈しません。全反復・中央値・平均・範囲・標準偏差を保持しています。
limitations.en: Most conditions have9successful trials;64-node hard has3. Maximum depends on sample count and is not interpreted as dedicated-system peak performance. All trials, median, mean, range and sample deviation are retained.

limitations.ja: buffered I/O、global cache flushなし。IOR Q=1は多くが同一ノード内のrank reorderでcold cacheを保証しません。logical bytes/timeまたはoperation rateで、物理device帯域ではありません。共有環境で逐次測定し、環境変動とスケーリングを分離できません。
limitations.en: Buffered I/O; no global cache flush. IOR Q=1 mostly reorders ranks within a node and does not establish cold cache. Logical bytes/time or operation rates, not physical device bandwidth. Serial shared-system observations cannot separate environmental variation from scaling.

limitations.ja: IO500 SC26 v1-inspiredの固定容量実験。300秒stonewallなし、IOR pinも参照実装と異なります。SC26安定化期間中の参照条件で、公式IO500合成スコアは計算していません。従来1ノード64 GiB easyは別系列です。
limitations.en: Fixed-volume IO500 SC26 v1-inspired experiment without300s stonewall and with a different IOR pin from the reference implementation. Reference conditions are from the SC26 stabilization period; no official IO500 composite score. Legacy one-node64GiB easy is a separate series.

limitations.ja: 初期1ノードのmemory不足と128ノード600秒timeoutの診断試行は保持し、修正後のprimary cohort集計から除外。128ノードhardは1,800秒phase capで再測定しました。256ノードeasy round1は失敗allocation内で完了したtrial1を検証し、独立easyのtrial2/3と結合。失敗allocationを成功扱いしていません。
limitations.en: Initial one-node memory failure and128-node600s-timeout diagnostic attempts are retained separately from corrected primary cohorts.128-node hard was remeasured with1,800s phase caps.256-node easy round1 combines verified trial1 from an allocation that later failed in hard with independent easy trials2/3; the failed allocation is not relabeled successful.

reproduction.commands:
# Allocate 256 nodes;4 ranks/node;4 GPUs/node;exclusive;all node memory.
# Use module nvhpc-hpcx/26.5 and pinned IOR/mdtest. No GPU computation.
# Set round to the matrix-wide cohort number;run one fresh cohort at a time.
: "${round:?set round to 1, 2, or 3}"
for trial in 1 2 3; do
  mkdir -p "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" "$OUT/round-$round"
  mpirun -np 1024 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -C --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-create.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 1024 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -T --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-stat.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 1024 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -E -X --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-read.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-read.log" 2>&1
  mpirun -np 1024 --map-by ppr:4:node --bind-to core "$BIN/mdtest" -a POSIX -n 2000 -F -P -G 27 -N 1 -i 1 -z 0 -b 1 -d "$DATA/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial" --dataPacketType=timestamp -t -w 3901 -e 3901 -r --saveRankPerformanceDetails="$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.csv" > "$OUT/round-$round/mdtest-hard-$trial-remove.log" 2>&1
  # Validate output, then remove only this trial synthetic payload before proceeding.
done

notes.ja: BINは記載commitのIOR/mdtest、DATAは測定対象FSの空の専用領域、OUTはログ保存先。private pathのみ変数へ置換。全matrixをnode昇順・条件順で逐次測定し、次roundは前roundの最後の成功条件終了から60分以上後。64ノードhardはround1のみ、256ノードhardは未完了です。
notes.en: BIN contains pinned IOR/mdtest; DATA is an empty dedicated area on the tested FS; OUT stores logs. Only private paths are normalized. Run the matrix serially in ascending node/scenario order; each next round starts at least60min after the final successful condition of the previous round.64-node hard has onlyround1;256-node hard is incomplete.

comparison_rule.ja: 同一ソフトウェア版・シナリオ・API・ノード/MPI配置・データ量・キャッシュ条件・反復数と妥当性を揃えて比較します。未実測のシステムを補完しません。 異種指標16件を合成スコアに集約しません。IORはMiB/s÷1024でGiB/s、mdtestはops/s÷1000でkops/sに換算できます。
comparison_rule.en: Compare matching software versions, scenarios, APIs, node/MPI placement, data volume, cache conditions, repetitions, and validity. Missing system measurements remain missing. The 16 heterogeneous observations are not combined into a score. IOR GiB/s = MiB/s ÷ 1024; mdtest kops/s = ops/s ÷ 1000.
